title: finding(types,plugin-kanban): `KanbanColumn.collapsed` is declared on both faces and honoured only by `KanbanEnhanced`, which no production source imports — the key objectui#8801's tombstone points authors at
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat (session `session_01VCpmqvacV4BypY48QdoxcE`). Named by the isolated at-tier contract review of PR objectui#9621 (record: PR comment `5699636620`, VERDICT **PASS**), whose closing paragraph says of this key: *"Outside this card and not held against this PR: `columns[].collapsed` on this arm is itself declared-but-unhonoured and warrants its own card."* ⛔ That verdict is adopted verbatim and this card does not reopen it.

⭐ This is the **same shape, one member over**, from the key objectui#8801 just retired — and it is the key that retirement's tombstone **names as the migration target**.

## Measured by this seat on the tree at `163630bc9`, ⛔ not quoted from the review

| reading | result |
|:--|:--|
| the declaration | `packages/types/src/complex.ts:151` — `collapsed?: boolean`, docblock: *"Whether the lane renders collapsed. Honoured by `KanbanEnhanced`"* |
| the mirror on this arm's lane type | `packages/types/src/objectql.ts:3680` — same member, docblock *"honoured by the enhanced board"* |
| who reads `column.collapsed` | **`packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanEnhanced.tsx` only** (:263, :273, :275, :277, :302, :313) |
| what the registered board reads | `KanbanImpl.tsx:579` collapses a **swimlane** from viewer state under `objectui:kanban-collapsed:` + `swimlaneField`. ⛔ It reads no lane's declared `collapsed`. |

## ⚠️ One correction to the review's wording, measured

The review says `KanbanEnhanced.tsx` "is imported by nothing". **Not quite** — it is imported by **two test files**:

- `packages/plugin-kanban/src/cardPredicateScope.test.tsx:22` (a real import, used at :57 / :74 / :85 / :89)
- `packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/kanban-handler-slots-7664.test.tsx:145` (a `vi.mock` of the module path)

Firing control, same walk: `ObjectKanban` is imported by production sources (`app-shell/.../block-config.ts`, `i18n.ts`, and more). ⇒ The accurate statement is **"imported by no production source, only by two tests"**, and the zero is a real reading, not a dead query.

⛔ This matters for whoever executes: a dev told "imported by nothing" may delete the file and break two live test suites.

## The defect

An author who writes this on an `object-kanban` node:

```json
{ "type": "object-kanban", "columns": [{ "id": "todo", "title": "To Do", "collapsed": true }] }
```

parses **green** on both faces, and gets **nothing** — the board that would have honoured it is registered nowhere. Same ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove shape the whole `ObjectKanban` arm has been worked through.

⭐ And it is now load-bearing in a second way: objectui#8801's retirement tombstone (landing in PR objectui#9621) names `KanbanColumn.collapsed` as where lane collapse lives. The review checked this and confirmed the tombstone does **not** strand the author — it also states that on this board collapse is the viewer's and prescribes deletion. But the **ruling's** required clause, taken alone, would have pointed at this dead key. ⇒ The platform is one careless docblock away from teaching a fiction.

## What is NOT measured here

- ⛔ Whether any real document authors `columns[].collapsed` today. This seat did not census `content/docs/**`, `examples/**`, `apps/**`. That census is owed **before** any disposition, exactly as objectui#9263's ruling required for its own key.
- ⛔ Whether `KanbanEnhanced` should be revived, deleted, or left as-is. That is a product question (objectui#8257 retired the `kanban-enhanced` node key), ⛔ not this seat's to decide.

## The ask

Measure first, then declare-or-remove. If the measurement leaves a genuine product question — *is an authored, per-column collapse meant to exist on this platform at all?* — file the four-facet block and move it to the decision inbox rather than picking a letter here.

`pm:queue`, unassigned. ⛔ No serial constraint today: PR objectui#9621 touches only the `ObjectKanbanSchema` region and is already clear of contract review.
